r1.text: Add a --reviewers option to pubprep so a run can use only some of the three reviewers. It takes a comma-separated list of short names: tech-debt, docs and security, for tech-debt-reviewer, readme-docs-reviewer and security-reviewer. parseArgs returns the choice as `reviewers`, the full agent names in the order tech-debt, docs, security whatever order they were typed, each once even when repeated. Without the flag, leave `reviewers` unset; a run then uses all three, as now. A missing or empty value is an error naming the valid short names, and a name that isn't one of the three is an error naming it and the valid short names. orchestrate takes the same list as an optional `reviewers` param (all three when omitted) and runs only those reviewers, in parallel or in sequence, so only their reports are written and concatenated into combined-review.md; main passes the parsed list through. Document the flag in the --help text. Add tests.
